rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Maintainer L136: "A fifth line landed 2026-08-23 (db2a68a4) ... and is now cut: the four lines above were deliberately only the first bullets, and the fifth mapped to no beat the deck teaches." Verbs 'landed' / 'is now cut' narrate a transition (session-dated, commit-hashed) rather than stating only the standing constraint + do-not-reintroduce reason. Harm check: low - the note leads with the current fact ("Block is four lines, not five") first, so a reader isn't actually misled about what's true now; the journey clause mainly adds a date+hash a future editor doesn't need (git blame carries it) but does also carry the do-not-reintroduce reasoning the rule explicitly sanctions keeping. Maintainer-only (not student-facing), so cost of leaving it is low. Rule's own text warns judges not to file section 3 on a dated-provenance header alone and to quote the transition verb before filing - quoted above, but harm is marginal, hence TODO not REVISE-blocking.
